about_the_game:
Manage your own video store and turn your business into a retro success!

In this laid-back management simulator, you're in charge of a store dedicated to selling physical movies. Buy, organize, sell, and improve your video store while enjoying a nostalgic experience inspired by the golden age of home entertainment.

Buy and Sell Movies

Choose which titles to add to your catalog, adjust pricing, and offer a variety of options to attract more customers.

Organize Your Shelves

Place your movies on the store’s shelves and define the layout and display style.

Customize Your Video Store (in development)

Decorate the space with unique visual elements to make your shop stand out.

Inventory System (in development)

Keep track of how many copies you have of each title, manage stock, and plan your restocks efficiently.

This version represents an early sample of the game in development. Content may be expanded or adjusted in the final release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600 / GeForce GT 1030 / Radeon R7
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / Radeon RX 560 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
